description:
pattern     media-matrix / stats
surface     dark
kit         ambient cyan orb centered behind counter values
form        Columns 1–12 present the statistics heading, followed by a single full-width horizontal glass panel partitioned by vertical hairlines into 5 metric cells with large animated counters and descriptive caption labels. On mobile, metrics arrange into a 2x2 grid with the fifth metric centered underneath.
copy
  eyebrow      BY THE NUMBERS
  heading      Four Years of Impact
  stat-1-val   4
  stat-1-lbl   Years of Dedicated Study
  stat-2-val   18+
  stat-2-lbl   Projects Engineered
  stat-3-val   25+
  stat-3-lbl   University & Tech Events Organized
  stat-4-val   8
  stat-4-lbl   Honors & Competition Awards
  stat-5-val   6
  stat-5-lbl   Industry Certifications Earned
motion      Numeric counters animate upward from zero upon scroll entry at 150ms over 1200ms duration using ease-out easing.
plan check  heading placed; animated counters for years (4), projects (18+), events (25+), achievements (8) and certifications (6) placed.
layout_description: Five-column horizontal metric strip with vertical dividers and centered numerical typography.
kit: ambient cyan orb centered behind counter values
